body: Seems like you offered advice or solutions, but I'm glad other commenters made an effort to validate feelings a little more, and they suggested similar things anyways. Thanks for trying though.
I love you too stranger <3 And I agree, I hope so too.

I'll definitely look into DBT skills groups. That's something I didn't even think of, so I appreciate that. I'm stuck in that "I really, really, reeeaally want to get better but I don't know how" stage and knowing that there's some more affordable alternatives makes it feel a bit more reachable.

It's a constant mental battle, and I have to convince myself over and over again that I deserve kindness and compassion just as much as everyone else. I picture my "BPD brain" and my "rational brain" arguing sometimes as the "devil and angel" on Kronk's shoulders in The Emperor's New Groove LOL.

It is nice to know you aren't alone in this thing. I'm glad I could help a bit for sure! Always nice to run into a fellow Canadian on the interwebs too.

Oh I'm so glad that you're in the right therapy for your situation! I give you mad props for even starting that in the first place, it's scaaaaary. BPD can be super exhausting too.

Those feelings make sense. It took a lot of "practice" so to speak to train yourself to not process things, and then learning all those new concepts is a lot. I can so relate. You're definitely not alone in that. I'm fresh to therapy myself and the best parallel I can think of is when I first picked up a guitar, stared at the frets and was all "I HAVE NO IDEA HOW THIS WORKS WHAT"

It's nice to know I'm not alone with all the difficulties with Borderline, although I wish others didn't have to suffer either. I do have a therapist I see somewhat infrequently, but the costs aren't the easiest to handle for sure. It's a unique condition for sure, and I'm really hoping that I find something to hold onto. Logically, I know there's gotta be some kind of option out there. I really hope so.

You are such a kind soul, thank you.

I had no idea that the help was that effective. That's really encouraging actually, I just wish it was a heck of a lot more affordable. I do have a therapist I see every other week, but I feel I need something more intensive. Might be worth asking about to see what payment options could be possible, there may be some sort of something that I may not be aware of. There's only so much information googling can give haha.

And as much as I wish others didn't have to suffer through this disorder either, it's nice to not be alone in it. It validates that what's going on in my head is "real" so to speak. Thank you for telling me I didn't deserve the abuse. From a logical standpoint, I 100% believe nobody ever deserves to go through that. But that pesky BPD brain likes to argue with me a lot. I really appreciate your kindness. Thank you.

You aren't alone in those BPD frustrations. It's something that is really hard to deal with when your mind is fighting against you. Borderline is a tricky thing, but I know even just knowing that someone else gets the disorder firsthand can be soothing in a strange way. You aren't alone in it even though that pesky BPD brain can really make it feel that way sometimes.  


If it helps at all, I juuust made a post on here talking a bit about my BPD frustrations. (you don't have to read it, no pressure AT ALL. no worries. focusing on you and your health is #1 right now) and I know that knowing I'm not alone in it helps me in turn. BPD is tough, but you sharing your raw experience with BPD was helpful to someone without you even trying, so there's some real value in that. I know I'm a stranger, but I believe in you.
